title: Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit Protocol: Fully Automated
author: Opentrons (verified)
materials: Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Input protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, enter the desired number of samples (up to 24) and any other settings; the protocol is optimized for up to 16 libraries in under 3 hours, uses lower aspiration flow rates, longer incubation times, reduced supernatant removal, and works with both generations of the magnetic module. Note that the run will pause when tips are exhausted, prompting tip‑rack replacement.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: After configuring the parameters, click the download button to save the generated Python protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons App, select “Upload Protocol”, browse to the downloaded .py file, and confirm the upload.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place all required labware (magnetic module, tip racks, plates, reservoirs, etc.) on the OT‑2 deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, run the calibration routine for each piece of labware and the pipette, employing the supplied calibration tips.

steps.title: Start automated run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the app; the robot will execute the full Swift 2S Turbo DNA Library Kit workflow automatically. Watch for tip‑rack depletion messages and replace tip racks when prompted.
